tour.offerDescription: Shall I show you around keyai in 2 minutes? You can also restart the tour in the settings.

steps.welcome: Welcome! Here you learn to read Japanese by typing. It is written with two alphabets among others, hiragana and katakana, and you will learn both side by side.
steps.line: Read each word and type how it sounds in Latin letters: か is typed ka. No need for a space, just keep going.
steps.lookup: Don’t know a kana? Look it up here: its reading is written just below. That’s what it’s for.
steps.tabs: “My kana” shows the ones you unlocked, the most recent first. Hiragana and Katakana show the full charts.
steps.mastery: The colour goes from red to green with your mastery, which depends on your speed and accuracy.
steps.unlock: When your latest kana are mastered, a new one unlocks. Here you see what is left to master.
steps.bar: Your speed, accuracy and errors, live. On the right, you choose the length of the series.
steps.stuck: Stuck on a word? Space skips it, but the series will unlock nothing. Escape starts a new series.
steps.quotes: Want some real Japanese? This mode offers 100 literary extracts. It does not count for your progress, so no pressure.
steps.display: Pick your level: all kana, kanji with their reading above, or kanji alone for the brave.
steps.result: At the end, you find the translation, the author and the work here. Enter for the next one, Tab to replay.
steps.lastSeries: After each series, you will find your speed, errors and the words you met here.
steps.progress: Your progress in each script, and soon how it evolves over time.
steps.anki: Do you use Anki? Add words from their card, then export them here in one click.
steps.speed: Too hard or too easy? Adjust the speed needed to master a kana here.
steps.session: You can revise hiragana or katakana alone, and choose how you type.
steps.end: Theme, kana size, save: it’s all in the settings. You can restart this tour here whenever you like. Enjoy your training!
steps.wordCards: Hover a word to see its full card and add it to your Anki list.
